    s_lengths, s_chars = zip(*s)
    
    t_total_length = sum(t_lengths)
    s_total_length = sum(s_lengths)

        return 0

    s_index = 0
    t_block_index = 0
    s_block_index = 0

                t_lengths[t_block_index] -= s_lengths[s_block_index]

            t_block_index += 1
            s_block_index = 0
